status: Native Inventory stock issue/consumption is PostgreSQL-qualified against the caller's sales reservation and stock sources; the Commerce same-transaction fulfillment call path remains open and no browser acceptance is claimed

scope.domain: Issue plan validation, proportional lot value allocation, full-quantity requirement, own-reservation exclusion, quarantine/lot depletion rejection and tampered-plan refusal.

scope.adapters: Reads current Sales source, persists lot movements/allocations and reservation effects, rechecks source versions, fences every reservation source and stock writer, and rolls back with the enclosing unit.
scope.frontend: No UI cutover in this slice.

tests: cargo test -p erpx-server-inventory --test stock_issue --test stock_issue_postgres --locked: 15 passed
